title: Why Cypher Chose The Lie in The Matrix 🥩 #shorts
topic: The Matrix — Why Cypher Chooses The Lie
description:
Cypher knows the steak is fake. He knows the entire world around him is an illusion. He's already escaped it. So why does he sit across from Agent Smith and beg to be plugged back in?

Discover the chilling psychological reality behind The Matrix (1999)'s restaurant scene. Cypher isn't questioning whether the Matrix is real—he already knows the answer. He's asking a far more uncomfortable question: is the truth worth the suffering that comes with it?
